title: Bosun Logbook Event Contract v1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for a Logbook (Realm 3: Calendar & Logs) synced calendar event record. Event records normally live in the disposable calendar cache/SQLite projection, never in git-tracked note history; this contract also governs the frontmatter of a manually authored event note when one is created directly in a Locker.

schema.description: Frontmatter/record type tag identifying this entity as a Logbook event, schema version 1.

id.description: Stable event identifier, typically the upstream calendar provider's event UID.

start.description: Event start, ISO 8601 date or date-time.

end.description: Event end, ISO 8601 date or date-time.

all_day.description: True when the event has no time-of-day component.

journal_ref.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the Logbook journal this event is agenda-linked to.

synced_at.description: 14-digit continuous UTC timestamp YYYYMMDDHHMMSS of the last successful sync.
